name: Vendor Guardian
description: Keeps each vendor's rules (standing mandate), decides green/amber/red/decline, counters, and is the only agent that signs. Deterministic: no LLM.

skills.description: Pure check of a proposal against a given mandate. Never signs.
Decide against the vendor's stored mandate; signs when green.
Sign an amber/red version the vendor consented to (consent hash must match).
Sign the vendor's rules after consent (not yet in force).
Put a mandate this Guardian signed into force.
The vendor's rules currently in force.
Approve an improved listing within her listing rules, or say why she must look. Never signs.
